commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Monza will take a corner kick.
90+2' The referee awards a corner and Patrick Ciurria (Monza) goes over to take it.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Paolo Zanetti decides to make a substitution. Dailon Rocha Livramento will be replaced by Junior Ajayi (Verona).
87' Kevin Martins (Monza) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
83' The referee signals a substitution. Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) is brought on as a substitute for Daniel Mosquera.
82' The substitution is prepared. Darko Lazovic (Verona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Domagoj Bradaric.
82' Salvatore Bocchetti has decided to substitute Tomas Palacios and he is replaced by Mirko Maric (Monza).
82' Here comes a substitution. Samuele Vignato is given a rest as he is replaced by Andrea Petagna (Monza).
80' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
78' Monza seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
75' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

75' Kevin Martins (Monza) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Monza force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
75' A cross from a corner kick by Monza is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
73' Substitution. Amin Sarr makes way for Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona).
72' Monza have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

71' A defender mistimes his tackle on the edge on the box and let's in Tomas Suslov (Verona). It's a decent effort but his shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.

70' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) won himself just enough space to connect with the corner inside the box. His header flew towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dived superbly to stop the effort.
70' Verona get a corner.
68' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) will deliver the corner kick.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Semuel Pizzignacco (Monza) is coming onto the pitch as Stefano Turati cannot continue after picking up an injury.
63' Tomas Palacios (Monza) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
61' Monza are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
59' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
58' Salvatore Bocchetti has decided to make a change. Kevin Martins (Monza) replaces Georgios Kyriakopoulos.
58' Substitution. Stefano Sensi is replaced by Gaetano Castrovilli (Monza).

57' Cheikh Niasse (Verona) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the right post to safety. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
56' Armando Izzo (Monza) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
56' Tomas Palacios (Monza) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Davide Massa saw the whole situation.
53' Cheikh Niasse (Verona) is booked by the referee.
52' Tomas Suslov (Verona) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
51' Neat passing move from Monza in order to create new attacking opportunities.
49' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
47' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Monza.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Paolo Zanetti gives a chance to Cheikh Niasse and Suat Serdar (Verona) is off.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' The injury to Suat Serdar (Verona) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
43' Suat Serdar (Verona) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
41' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
39' Stefan Lekovic (Monza) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
35' The ball is out of play. Monza will have a chance to score from a corner.
35' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The referee blows his whistle, Monza are awarded a corner kick.
33' Some great play by Dany Mota (Monza) ends with a shot on the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Lorenzo Montipo sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
29' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) receives a yellow card.
28' Monza enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
25' Davide Massa blows his whistle. Amin Sarr (Verona) commits a foul after dangerous play. Monza earn a free kick.
21' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 59:41.
18' The linesman makes the right call and Monza will have a corner.
17' Great teamplay by Verona as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
16' Davide Massa blows for a foul after Stefan Lekovic (Monza) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
13' 0 - 1 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Stefan Lekovic (Monza), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it into the right post of his own goal.
13' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Suat Serdar (Verona).
10' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
9' The Verona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
6' Tomas Suslov (Verona) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

6' Suat Serdar (Verona) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt. It will be a corner kick for Verona.
5' The Monza players are exchanging some short passes.
2' The Monza players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
